Updated review : This company has been ripping us off…. I would like to update everyone who has read my bad review about Thames Water. I got in contact with Thames Water today July 6, 2023 and finally the issues were fixed. New meter was installed, a manager named "Hayley"rang me and she has taken the current reading on the new meter, then she has done a manual adjustments and calculated the discrepancies and it took our account into credit and we are due a refund. So I am truly relieved that this problem is resolved now. It's been a pain and now it's resolved I'm happy---------------------------------This company has been ripping us off for years. We moved to this flat in 2016 we got our bill as normal. Then we decided to just wash our clothes to a laundrette to see if it can lower our water bill because it increases every 6 months. we were most of the time not at home because we both work and we go on holidays every year and leaves the property for like 3 to 4 weeks.. But instead the bill went up each time. We contacted them to ask about the meter where is it and they gave us the meter location, but found nothing. We pay a ridiculous amount of £40, £50 a month in the past years and this year £99. Because they estimated our future water consumption. Load of lies because they say we have a meter but if we do why do they need to estimate. My friends and even other people say their bill a month for a household of 5 was just £23.Cut story short, we insisted on having a meter checked until they sent not 1 but 2 engineers to check. But both of them found nothing. Meaning our bill was obviously based on Assessed household charge. No meter or maybe imaginary one. Estimated bill every year. Now they fitted a meter on June 7, 2023 and in 3 weeks that we wash clothes at home 3 times a week our consumption was just 5.920 cubic meters and it's just £13.48. The date of experience indicated in this review was when we followed up with Thames through whatsapp messaging to ask for an engineer to come over to show us the meter because they failed to send one in 2020 because of covid restrictions but we have been going in circles with them since 2019.
